items.title: T Mobile US (TMUS) Sets Up A Long Term CFO Succession Plan
items.summary: T-Mobile US (NasdaqGS:TMUS) has appointed former Shell finance head Jessica Uhl as CFO Designate as part of a planned transition. Uhl will work alongside current CFO Peter Osvaldik during a defined handover period ahead of his expected retirement. The CFO succession plan includes an extended overlap that is intended to support continuity in financial policy and investor engagement.
